extracted.intended_audience: mathematics education researchers, potential authors, readers, and librarians
extracted.subtask_description: Extract and summarise the journal-level publication policies, scope, metrics, themed-issue topics, and indexing information presented on the ZDM – Mathematics Education Springer Nature journal homepage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Journal scope / forum purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: ZDM – Mathematics Education is a forum for critical analysis, surveying, and building upon current research and theoretical-based perspectives in mathematics education.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This statement defines the journal's intellectual remit: critical analysis, surveys, and theory-based perspectives in mathematics education — i.e., work should engage with current research and theory.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication model: invitation-only themed issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Publishes invitation-only papers in seven annual themed issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The journal primarily publishes invited papers organized into themed issues (seven per year). Submissions from general unsolicited calls may be limited; authors should note the invitation-oriented model and themed-issue structure when considering submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target readership
rubrics_metrics.description: Targets readers globally in mathematics education research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content should be of international relevance within the field of mathematics education; authors and editors aim for a global research audience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Journal Impact Factor (JIF)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The reported JIF is presented as a bibliometric indicator of journal influence for 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: 5-year Journal Impact Factor
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The 5-year JIF is provided as a longer-term impact metric for the journal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission-to-first-decision time (median)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The median elapsed time from submission to the first editorial decision is displayed as a speed/turnaround metric for prospective authors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Downloads / readership volume
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Total article downloads are shown as an indicator of usage and readership volume (reported for 2025).

rubrics_metrics.name: Open access content volume
rubrics_metrics.description: This journal has 429 open access articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The count of open-access articles indicates the extent of freely available content in the journal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Latest issue theme and focus
rubrics_metrics.description: Latest issue (June 2026) Volume 58, Issue 3 — 'Integration of cognitive neuroscience in research on mathematical thinking, learning and problem-solving'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides an example of recent themed-issue focus; signals topic areas the journal emphasizes in current publishing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Planned and recent themed-issue topics (editorial priorities)
rubrics_metrics.description: Lists multiple themed issues for 2025–2027 (examples: 'Developing students’ reasoning with data and data-ing'; 'International perspectives on mathematical modelling'; 'Mathematics textbooks for curriculum development and instructional reform'; 'Teacher expertise and competence'; 'Motivation in mathematics education'; 'Artificial intelligence in mathematics education research'; 'Enhancing data literacy for citizenship'; 'Out-of-field teaching in mathematics'; 'Feedback in assessment'; 'Computational thinking for mathematics education'; etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The enumerated themes across years indicate the journal's topical priorities and the types of special-issue calls/editors it commissions; useful for authors to identify alignment with their work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Webinar recordings linked to special issues
rubrics_metrics.description: ZDM webinar recordings: Webinars on special issues of ZDM – Mathematics Education (titles listed), recordings can be found here.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The journal provides webinars tied to special issues as outreach and community engagement; these are resources for authors/readers to learn about special-issue themes and editorial perspectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abstracting and indexing coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: Abstracted and indexed in: BFI List; Baidu; CLOCKSS; CNKI; CNPIEC; Chinese Academy of Medical Science (CAMS); Current Contents/Social & Behavioral Sciences; Dimensions; EBSCO; ERIC; ERIH PLUS; Google Scholar; Japanese Science and Technology Agency (JST); Naver; Norwegian Register for Scientific Journals and Series; OCLC WorldCat Discovery Service; Ovid Discovery; Portico; ProQuest; SCImago; SCOPUS; Social Science Citation Index; TD Net Discovery Service; Wanfang; eLibrary.ru.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The extensive indexing list indicates discoverability and institutional access channels; useful for authors assessing visibility and library/information-science reach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial leadership
rubrics_metrics.description: Editor-In-Chief: Prof. Gabriele Kaiser PhD; Associate Editors: Prof. Roza Leikin PhD; Prof. Thorsten Scheiner PhD; Prof. Stanislaw Schukajlow PhD; Prof. Anselm Strohmaier PhD (view all editors).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editorial board composition is provided to indicate editorial stewardship and expertise areas; authors may consult editors' research interests to assess fit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Journal history / standing
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the oldest mathematics education research journals in publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This descriptive claim signals the journal's longevity and established position in the field; not a submission criterion but context for reputation.
